headline: Dollar and Euro Drop Rapidly: NBU Rate for September 8 and What to Expect from the Currency Market
summary: The National Bank of Ukraine lowered its official dollar and euro rates, and local experts are commenting on the outlook for the currency market in coming days.
why: The NBU sets the official hryvnia exchange rate, which anchors currency conversion and inflation expectations in Ukraine.
